items.stem: A student writes that the Ottoman Empire 'declined steadily and inevitably from its peak'. Why do historians challenge this?

options.text: The empire adapted and reformed over centuries; 'decline' oversimplifies a complex, uneven history
options.rationale: Correct: the linear-decline model ignores adaptation, reform and regional variation.

options.text: Because the empire never weakened at all
options.rationale: It faced real pressures; the issue is the simplistic narrative.
It had powerful periods; the caution is about the framing of change.
It ended after the First World War.
